bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 100 日均线，测试 $171.7

read.en: Palantir rose 5.5% on Nov 9 to $169.20, trading $161.05–170.83. It is above the falling 5-day ($166.33), rising 100-day ($164.64) and falling 200-day ($153.53) averages, but below the falling 10-day ($178.61) and 30-day ($190.26). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($182.19), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: Palantir 11月9日上涨 5.5%，收于 $169.20，盘中区间 $161.05–170.83。股价位于下行的 5 日（$166.33）、上行的 100 日（$164.64）和下行的 200 日均线（$153.53）上方，但仍在下行的 10 日（$178.61）和 30 日均线（$190.26）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$182.19），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The close reclaimed $164.6–166.3 (100-day, Sep 10 and Nov 4 lows, 5-day), now support; the $170.83 high stopped under the $171.7 Nov 4 close. Resistance is $170.8–171.7, then $178.3–178.6 (Nov 2 close, 10-day) and $182.2 (SAR). Support is $164.6–166.3, then $156.3–158.3 (March–April highs, Aug 5 low) and $152.6–153.5 (Nov 5 low, 200-day). A close above $171.7 would target $178–179; below $164.6, $157–158.
